On bingwu, Zheng Shen was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi.
On bingwu, Zheng Shen, Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi.
The idiomatic English omits Zheng Shen's office 太子少師, Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
Day bingwu: Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zheng Shen was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi.
Day bingwu: Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Zheng Shen was made Kaifu Yitong Sansi.
太子少師 is the Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent; Grand Mentor renders 太子少保 elsewhere in this chapter.
Sixth month, jiayin: Cai Jing was restored as grand mentor of the heir apparent.
Sixth month, jiayin: Cai Jing was restored as junior preceptor of the heir apparent.
太子少師 is the Junior Preceptor; Grand Mentor renders 太子少保, the post Cai Jing was demoted to in Daguan 4.
Sixth month, day jiayin: Cai Jing was restored as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
Sixth month, day jiayin: Cai Jing was restored as Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
太子少師 is the Junior Preceptor; Grand Mentor renders 太子少保.
That month Zheng Yunzhong and Tong Guan went to Liao; Li Liangsi came in return, offered a plan to seize Yan, and was granted the surname Zhao.
That month Zheng Yunzhong and Tong Guan went to Liao; they brought back Li Liangsi, who, offered a plan to seize Yan, and was granted the surname Zhao.
以李良嗣來 means the envoys brought Li Liangsi back with them.
That month Zheng Yunzhong and Tong Guan were envoys to Liao; Li Liangsi came in their stead, presented a plan to take Yan, and was ordered granted the surname Zhao.
That month Zheng Yunzhong and Tong Guan were envoys to Liao; they brought Li Liangsi back with them, who, presented a plan to take Yan, and was ordered granted the surname Zhao.
以李良嗣來 means the envoys brought Li Liangsi back with them, not that he came in their stead.
